query:
MATCH (p:player)
RETURN p.id AS id, p.age AS age
ORDER BY age DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC
OFFSET 1
LIMIT 2;
notes: Generated independently from the public q_page prompt and current query skill references. Explicit NULLS LAST and unique id tie-breaker preserve the requested pagination. No age filter, graph selection, or writes. Not executed against a database.
